scope: One fully labelled sampled-video prefix; visible-fire episodes, not wildfire incidents or field performance
episode: Maximal contiguous run of positive sampled labels or alarms, with half-open sample indices [start, end)
matching: An alarm onset must lie inside a truth episode. Match the first such onset only; subsequent onsets in that episode are duplicates. An alarm starting before an episode receives no credit for later overlap.
sampled_exposure_s: n_samples / sample_fps, nominal sampled-bin exposure, not independently measured source duration
alarm_precision: matched alarm episodes / all alarm episodes; duplicates reduce precision
false_alarm_episodes: Alarm onsets on samples labelled no visible fire; duplicates within visible fire are reported separately
delay: First matched alarm onset minus sampled truth onset, divided by sample_fps; only matched episodes enter delay quantiles
delay_quantile: Nearest rank: sorted detected delays at ceil(p * n) - 1, for p=0.5 and p=0.9
zero_denominator: null, never zero or perfect performance
censoring: Retain episodes touching either observed-prefix edge; flag left/right censoring and report sampled-onset delays, not ignition delay
split: Only a packet assigned test before annotation may be evaluated; recording, incident, site and date separation still require external governance
labels: Complete binary visible-fire labels at every decoded sample; blank/uncertain labels fail evaluation rather than being silently dropped
uncertainty: No confidence intervals or acceptance verdict from one recording; recording-clustered uncertainty and independent held-out data remain future work
non_goals: No threshold fitting, test-set retuning, model training or probability calibration
No downloaded/bundled datasets, weights or footage
No empirical detector accuracy, smoke-detection or generalization claim
No real-time service, flight integration or deployment
